issues.description: Several candidates (APOE, HIF1A, APOC1, MKI67, ANLN, CDK6, MMP11, FCN1, MHC/immune genes, GATA3, FOXA1, SOX4, TMSB10, AZGP1) are functional, state, or differentially expressed genes, not formal annotation markers; they were therefore judged context_only.

Exact Leiden cluster counts are not reported for global sc/snRNA-seq clustering, spatial method-wise clustering, or MERFISH de novo clustering; final annotation label counts were used where available, but complete cluster-level audit is limited by the text.
CD56 was normalized to NCAM1 and CD8 to CD8A because the paper uses protein/CD nomenclature rather than standard gene symbols.
